text:
deploybot: Canary health alert — canary set for release v2.8.1 registered 3/5 failing health checks. Automatic deploy pause engaged. Related incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-202403/brief. Use `/deploy status` to inspect queue.

maria: seeing a spike of 500s from tokenizer service in eu-west, timestamps line up with canary start. @jordan can you pull logs?

jordan: on it. I'm going to roll the canary pods back to v2.8.0 to verify if the tokenizer change is the culprit. If rollback clears, we can re-run a constrained canary.

sre-oncall: recommend pinning the release slot and not advancing other lanes. Also proposing a +2h shift to the US change window to give ops time to confirm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: +1 on the window bump. I'll update the release notes and ping Comms. Suggest we add a soft rollback trigger: error rate >2% sustained for 10m.

maria: rollback command: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/canary tokenizer=v2.8.0 && kubectl rollout status deploy/canary -w` — rolling back now.

jordan: rollback succeeded, canary health returned to baseline. Recommend we keep the hold and rerun a reduced-traffic canary at 10% for 15m before unfreezing queue.

deploybot: Hold remains. Queues frozen for lanes: stable, priority-high. Resume steps: run `/deploy resume <slot>` after confirming items in docs/release-checklist.md and post-rollout monitoring. Postmortem stub should be created in #postmortems.

sam: I'll draft the release note addition: "temporary delay due to runtime tokenizer regression; canary rollback performed and revalidation scheduled." Will ping growth + comms once text is ready.

jordan: @maria can you schedule the smaller canary in ~30m? If flakiness persists we'll perform a full rollout rollback and open the rollback PR/merge.

maria: scheduling now. Also enabling extra KV cache debug logging to capture correlation with tokenizer. tagging @sre-oncall for visibility. :eyes:

sre-oncall: acknowledged. US release slot moved from 00:00 UTC to 02:00 UTC; sending formal reschedule notice to stakeholders and updating the release calendar.
